note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. The registry, its reference and every date are fictional, supplied placeholders. Only supplied relationships are drawn, without arrowheads (a causal link only when supplied); the order is captioned 'Sequence as configured (illustrative)'. Nothing states a filing rule, fee, court, deadline or effect. Long-labels-stress: coordinator decision (standing stress rule, AUTHORING item 20, 2026-09-26): the five component labels and the three stage captions are capped (see the preset description); every other field keeps its near-maximum length.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative

Focus on the filing; different parties and documents.

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Near-maximum lengths: long party names and roles, element labels, relation labels, filing contents, date line, reference, seven day labels and stage captions. coordinator decision (standing stress rule, AUTHORING item 20, 2026-09-26): the five component labels and the three stage captions are capped to the longest values found to fit every ratio at >= 16 px without scaling — component labels 'Case file for the fictional claim' 33 → 'Case file of the fictional claim' 32, 'Written filing signed by Party A' 32 → 'Written filing by Party A' 25, 'Registry intake tray for filings' 32 → 'Registry intake tray' 20, 'Registry entries calendar (as supplied)' 39 → 'Registry entries calendar' 25, 'Reference box on the written filing' 35 → 'Reference box on the filing' 27; stage captions 'Handed in by Party A along the counter track' 44 → 'Handed in by Party A at the counter' 35, 'Registered at the desk · fictional reference given' 50 → 'Registered · fictional reference given' 38, 'Draft kept in Party A's tray, unfiled (supplied)' 48 → 'Draft kept by Party A, unfiled (supplied)' 41. Each stays longer than its baseline value; party names and roles, relationship labels, documents, the reference and the seven day labels keep their near-maximum lengths, and all counts are kept. Measured (rendered, 1:1, text floor 16.4 px): with the near-maximum values, relation labels 1, 4 and 5 found no free spot and the rendered checks failed (text on filler bars, a state tag over a component, a card over text). Tried first: repositioned square components, a wider single-row calendar (0.56 of the width), more relaxation rounds, capping only the relationship labels, and capping only the component labels (passed once, then failed again after the compact filing sheet was lowered — so the stage captions are capped too).
